Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> looks distressed and is trying to understand what went wrong during the quest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、苦しみながら原因を考えた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>苦恼地思索着原因。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>苦惱地思索著原因。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Échouant dans sa quête, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> est en détresse et cherche à comprendre la cause de son échec.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> war verzweifelt, nachdem die Mission gescheitert war, und grübelte über die Ursache nach.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se siente angustiada e intenta comprender qué salió mal en la misión.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Aflita com o fracasso da missão, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ponderava as causas.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูเครียดและพยายามทำความเข้าใจว่าอะไรผิดพลาดไประหว่างภารกิจ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> merasa tertekan dan mencoba memahami apa yang salah selama misi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Nhiệm vụ thất bại, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> cảm thấy đau đớn và suy nghĩ kỹ lưỡng về nguyên nhân.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: अनुरोध में विफल होकर <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> परेशान दिखती है और यह समझने की कोशिश कर रही है कि क्या गलत हुआ।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Let's go back and think about it.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: กลับไปคิดกันเถอะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Hãy quay lại và suy nghĩ.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: चलो वापस चलते हैं और इस बारे में सोचते हैं।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Here. Drink this and perk up.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: これでも飲んで、元気出して。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Tiens. Bois ça et reprends des forces.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Hier. Trink das und muntere dich auf.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Toma. Bebe esto y recupera fuerzas.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Beba isso e recupere suas forças.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: นี่ ดื่มนี่แล้วร่าเริงขึ้นหน่อยสิ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đây. Uống cái này vào cho lấy lại tinh thần.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: यह लो। इसे पियो और जोश में आओ!

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 휴식을 취하는 것도 현명한 생각이라고 판단했다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided that taking a break might be a wise choice.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、休息を取るのも賢明だと判断した。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>认为适当休息也是明智之举。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>認為適當休息也是明智之舉。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> décida qu'une pause serait une sage décision.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> entschied, dass eine Pause eine kluge Wahl sein könnte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió que tomar un descanso podría ser una sabia elección.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidiu que fazer uma pausa também seria uma escolha sábia.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ตัดสินใจว่าการพักผ่อนอาจเป็นทางเลือกที่ฉลาด
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memutuskan bahwa beristirahat mungkin adalah pilihan yang bijaksana.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quyết định rằng nghỉ ngơi cũng là một lựa chọn khôn ngoan.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फैसला किया कि ब्रेक लेना भी एक समझदारी भरा विचार हो सकता है।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 쓴웃음을 짓고 돌아서는 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>의 발걸음이 평소보다 무거워 보인다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: With a faint, bitter smile, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> turned away, her steps heavier than usual.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 苦笑いを浮かべ背を向けた<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>の足取りは、いつもより重そうだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 苦笑着转身离开的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>，脚步比平时看起来更加沉重。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 苦笑著轉身離開的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>，腳步比平時看起來更加沉重。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Avec un léger sourire amer, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tourna les talons, ses pas plus lourds que d'habitude.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Mit einem leichten, bitteren Lächeln drehte sich <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> um, ihre Schritte waren schwerer als sonst.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Con una leve y amarga sonrisa, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se dio la vuelta, sus pasos más pesados de lo habitual.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Com um sorriso fraco e amargo, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se virou, seus passos mais pesados que o normal.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ด้วยรอยยิ้มจาง ๆ ที่ขมขื่น <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> หันหลังกลับ ก้าวเดินของเธอหนักอึ้งกว่าปกติ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Dengan senyum pahit yang samar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> berbalik, langkahnya lebih berat dari biasanya.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Với nụ cười gượng, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quay đi, bước chân nặng nề hơn thường lệ.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: एक हल्की, कड़वी मुस्कान के साथ, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> मुड़ गई, उसके कदम सामान्य से अधिक भारी दिख रहे थे।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quickly bounced back to her usual self after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はポーションを受け取ると、元気を取り戻した。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> retrouva rapidement son entrain après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> erholte sich schnell, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> recuperó rápidamente su estado habitual después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> recuperou o ânimo depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> กลับมาเป็นปกติอย่างรวดเร็วหลังจากได้รับยา
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dengan cepat kembali ke dirinya yang biasa setelah menerima ramuan itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã lấy lại tinh thần sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> पोशन मिलने के बाद तुरंत अपने सामान्य रूप में वापस आ गई।
